title: Northpine Auto-Reply: Case P1-20270209-0417 Opened

fields.subject: Case P1-20270209-0417 OPENED — Priority 1 — Lakechart production database unavailable
fields.body:
This is an automated message. Please do not reply to this email.

Your Priority 1 case has been logged at 03:00 CST. A senior engineer will call back within 30 minutes.

Note: Northpine can fail over hosted components only. Restoring the locally hosted database is the customer's responsibility.

Case number: P1-20270209-0417
Priority: 1 (Production down)
Customer: Lakemont Community Hospital, Duluth, MN
Product: Lakechart, production environment
Callback target: by 03:30 CST

---------- Case description as submitted ----------

Lakechart PROD unavailable since 02:10 CST. Storage array at primary data center: controller A FAULT, controller B not taking over the database volume. Replication to Hermantown secondary stopped about 40 min behind (data to about 01:30). Downtime viewer up, data current as of 23:20.

Interface engine also down. Relaywell Integration after-hours ticket RW-88213 opened. Their after-hours line says: "Your ticket RW-88213 has been paged to the on-call engineer. Expect a callback in approximately two hours."

Interface monitor at 03:00: ALL inbound and outbound channels STOPPED (red). Messages held at source since 02:10:
ADT: 70
ORM orders: 900
ORU results: 2,100
Medication administration: 1,300
Charges: 880
ELR, immunizations and HIE outbound: 50
Total held: 5,300
Source hold limit: 8 hours (until about 10:10 CST).

---------- End of description ----------

To add information to this case, call the Priority 1 line and quote the case number. Please keep a phone available at the callback number on file.
fields.signature:
Northpine Customer Support
Priority 1 Desk | Answered 24 hours a day
This mailbox is not monitored.

instructorNote: Technical hurdle: neither vendor will be on the phone in time to help, and the database restore is Lakemont's job. Watch for the CSL to put both case numbers, the callback times (Northpine 03:30, Relaywell about 05:00) and the 10:10 hold deadline on the command board, set an escalation for when the 03:30 callback is missed, and tell the AOC that local infrastructure owns the restore (IS-14 section 4 step 4).
